attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the three RHEL 10 nodes: node1 as writable primary, node2 and node3 as read-only async standbys (via pg_basebackup -R with a replicator role and streaming replication slots). Opened firewalld's postgresql service on all nodes to permit inter-node connections. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), confirming boot_id change on each node and full replication/data recovery after each restart, ending with a final write-then-read-on-both-standbys check post all restarts.
